title: Dürbün flow
description: A Dürbün flow: nodes (steps) connected by edges, run by the Dürbün Mac app against a device and an app.

id.description: File-safe id, unique among the flows

inputs.description: Values asked for when the flow starts or passed by a calling flow; read as {{input.<name>}}

outputs.description: Values a calling flow reads as {{<call node id>.outputs.<name>}}

appId.description: Bundle id / package name of the app under test

oneOf.title: Manual start
oneOf.description: Where a run starts when someone presses Run. Flow inputs are read as {{input.<name>}}.

oneOf.title: When something happens
oneOf.description: Starts the flow on its own when the event happens on a connected device (only while the flow's automation switch is on and Dürbün is open). The run targets the device and app of the event. Event data is read as {{trigger.<field>}}.

text.description: Text the log line contains (or a regex when `regex` is on).

appId.description: Only this app (bundle id / package). Empty = the flow's target app, or any app when the flow has none.

oneOf.title: HTTP request
oneOf.description: Sends a request from the Mac (not through the app, so it works with any build). The response is the step output; it also shows in the Network tab under "Desktop".

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL; usually starts with {{env.baseUrl}}.

query.description: Query parameters appended to the URL.

bodyType.description: Body: 'none', 'json' (sends `body` as JSON), 'text' (sends `body` as is), 'form' (x-www-form-urlencoded from `form`).

body.description: JSON body (bodyType json) or text (bodyType text). Strings may contain templates. Without a body type, an object or list goes as JSON and text as plain text; the step notes it.

expectStatus.description: Fail the step unless the status matches: '2xx', '200', '200,201', '200-299'. Empty = any status passes.

extract.description: Save values from the response as variables ({{vars.<name>}}).

timeoutMs.description: Give up after this many milliseconds.

oneOf.title: Condition
oneOf.description: Checks rules and continues through `true` or `false`.

mode.description: 'all' = every rule must hold, 'any' = one is enough.

oneOf.title: Repeat
oneOf.description: Runs everything connected to `loop` up to `count` times (one iteration ends when its steps end or come back to this node), then continues through `done`. With `until` rules it stops as soon as they hold — use it to poll ("until the order is ready"). The iteration number is {{<id>.index}} (0-based).

count.description: Most iterations (0 = none). A template that gives a list (e.g. {{getOrders.body.items}}), or a JSON list in text, runs once per element, read as {{item}}.

until.description: Stop early when all these rules hold (checked after each iteration).

failIfNotMet.description: Fail when `until` never held within `count` iterations.

oneOf.title: Set variables
oneOf.description: Sets variables read as {{vars.<name>}} later in the run.

oneOf.title: Wait
oneOf.description: Waits a fixed time.

oneOf.title: Check
oneOf.description: Fails the run when an assertion does not hold. Use it for what a tester would verify.

assertions.description: left, op, right and an optional message.

oneOf.title: No errors so far
oneOf.description: Fails when the app crashed during the run on the target device; by default also when its requests failed or got a 5xx response, and optionally when it logged error/fatal lines.

networkFailures.description: Also fail on failed requests and 5xx responses of the app.

errorLogs.description: Also fail on error/fatal log lines of the app.

oneOf.title: Run another flow
oneOf.description: Runs another flow (sub-flow) with inputs and continues with its outputs: {{<id>.outputs.<name>}}. The sub-flow uses the same device, app and environment.

flowId.description: Id of the flow to run.

inputs.description: Values for the sub-flow's inputs: { name: template }.

oneOf.title: End the run
oneOf.description: Ends the run here as passed or failed. Inside a sub-flow it ends that sub-flow: failed makes the calling step fail (its error edge can handle it), passed returns to the caller.

oneOf.title: Open a link (deep link)
oneOf.description: Opens a URL or deep link on the device.

oneOf.title: Launch the app
oneOf.description: Starts the app (brings it to the front when it runs).

appId.description: Bundle id / package name of the app. Defaults to the run's app ({{target.appId}}).

oneOf.title: Stop the app
oneOf.description: Force-stops the app.

appId.description: Bundle id / package name of the app. Defaults to the run's app ({{target.appId}}).

oneOf.title: Restart the app
oneOf.description: Stops and launches the app again.

appId.description: Bundle id / package name of the app. Defaults to the run's app ({{target.appId}}).

oneOf.title: Clear app data
oneOf.description: Deletes the app data (fresh install state). Cannot be undone.

appId.description: Bundle id / package name of the app. Defaults to the run's app ({{target.appId}}).

oneOf.title: Install a build
oneOf.description: Installs an .apk / .ipa / .app from a path on this Mac.

file.description: Absolute path of the build on this Mac.

oneOf.title: Uninstall the app
oneOf.description: Removes the app and its data. Cannot be undone.

appId.description: Bundle id / package name of the app. Defaults to the run's app ({{target.appId}}).

oneOf.title: Screenshot
oneOf.description: Takes a screenshot and keeps it with the run as evidence.

oneOf.title: Start screen recording
oneOf.description: Starts recording the screen; "Stop screen recording" (or the end of the run) saves the video with the run.

maxSeconds.description: Stop by itself after this many seconds (platform limits: Android 180, iOS 600).

oneOf.title: Stop screen recording
oneOf.description: Stops the recording and keeps the video with the run.

oneOf.title: Dark / light mode
oneOf.description: Switches the system appearance.

oneOf.title: Font size
oneOf.description: Sets the system font scale (1 = default).

oneOf.title: Set location
oneOf.description: Moves the simulated location (simulators and emulators).

oneOf.title: Send a push notification
oneOf.description: Delivers a push payload to the app (iOS simulator).

appId.description: Bundle id / package name of the app. Defaults to the run's app ({{target.appId}}).

oneOf.title: Type text
oneOf.description: Types into the focused field (Android).

oneOf.title: Press a key
oneOf.description: Presses a hardware or system key (Android).

oneOf.title: Clean status bar
oneOf.description: Shows a clean status bar for screenshots, or resets it (iOS simulator).

oneOf.title: System animations
oneOf.description: Turns system animations on or off (Android).

oneOf.title: Wait for an app request
oneOf.description: Waits until the app under test makes a matching request and it finishes, then outputs it like an HTTP request step (status, headers, body…). Needs the app's network capture (Dürbün SDK).

status.description: Only responses with this status: '2xx', '200,201' (empty = any, failed requests included).

timeoutMs.description: Give up after this many milliseconds.

since.description: Which events count: 'previous' (default) also catches what happened while the previous step ran (e.g. the request a deep link caused), 'run' anything since the run started, 'now' only what happens after this step starts.

oneOf.title: Wait for a log line
oneOf.description: Waits until a matching log line appears on the target device (device logs work without the SDK).

text.description: Text the line contains (or a regex when `regex` is on).

regex.description: Treat `text` as a regular expression; group 1 becomes {{<id>.match}}, every group {{<id>.groups}}.

appOnly.description: Only lines of the run's app.

timeoutMs.description: Give up after this many milliseconds.

since.description: Which events count: 'previous' (default) also catches what happened while the previous step ran (e.g. the request a deep link caused), 'run' anything since the run started, 'now' only what happens after this step starts.

oneOf.title: Wait for an app event
oneOf.description: Waits for a custom event the app sends with the Dürbün SDK (Durbun.event(name, props)).

timeoutMs.description: Give up after this many milliseconds.

since.description: Which events count: 'previous' (default) also catches what happened while the previous step ran (e.g. the request a deep link caused), 'run' anything since the run started, 'now' only what happens after this step starts.

oneOf.title: Add a mock
oneOf.description: Adds a mock rule the app's SDK applies to matching requests: respond with a fake response, add delay, or fail. Removed when the run ends unless `keep` is on. Needs the Dürbün SDK in the app.

action.description: 'respond' = fake response, 'delay' = slow down the real request, 'fail' = network error.

appOnly.description: Apply only to the run's app.

keep.description: Keep the rule after the run.

oneOf.title: Turn a mock on/off
oneOf.description: Enables or disables an existing mock rule (by id or name). Restored after the run unless `keep` is on.

keep.description: Keep the change after the run.

oneOf.title: Remove a mock
oneOf.description: Removes a mock rule (by id or name) — also one added earlier in this run.

oneOf.title: Timeline marker
oneOf.description: Adds a marker line to the log timeline of the device, so the run is easy to find in the logs.

oneOf.title: Send to Slack
oneOf.description: Posts a message to the team's Slack channel (Settings → Slack), optionally with the run summary so far.

oneOf.title: Note
oneOf.description: Writes a line into the run report (e.g. "Order {{vars.orderId}} created").

port.description: out (most nodes), true/false (logic.condition), loop/done (logic.repeat), error (every node with input except flow.end)

nodeId.description: Unique node id; templates read its output as {{<id>.<field>}}

right.description: Template or literal; required except for exists, notExists, isEmpty, isNotEmpty, isTrue and isFalse. For `in`: a comma-separated list ('a, b') or a JSON list (['a', 'b']).
Template or literal; required except for exists, notExists, isEmpty, isNotEmpty, isTrue and isFalse. For `in`: a comma-separated list ('a, b') or a JSON list (['a', 'b']).

path.description: JSON path for body (items[0].id), header name for header
